instruction:
Three Storey Mixed Use Retrofit IFC

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a three-storey mixed-use scheme and export the completed model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 3 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 9 IfcSpace entities, 12 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, and 18 IfcWindow entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token retail at least once, lobby at least once, office at least 4 times, corridor at least 2 times, and back service at least once.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
